decisions.reason: As a close-to-core launch with its own product page in a growing and investing firm, it is likely still above or near aspiration under early uncertainty, so slack supports keeping it.

Because this generic antidepressant is more distant from the firm’s established offer and faces tougher undifferentiated competition, it is the most likely to fall short of aspiration, but the firm’s current expansion and limited post-launch evidence still make retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.

This antihypertensive tablet fits the firm’s established prescription-pharma capabilities well and was actively presented, so management would likely keep it while learning whether it can meet aspiration levels.

Although the website signal is weaker because it was only mentioned, the supplement builds on the firm’s established self-care direction and strategic aim to grow differentiated pharmacy products, so organizational slack favors keeping it for now.
